headline: Visualise
subtitle: See it before you build it.
description: Build a 3D replica of the venue in Designer. Preview content, scenery and screens together, so the team can make creative and technical decisions before arriving on site.
subtitle_2: Make the content fit the world.
description_2: Map pixels to physical LED and projection surfaces, including curves and unusual shapes. Plan projection in Mapping Matter; align real projectors with calibration tools such as OmniCal.
description_3: Blend video, generative graphics and real-time engines in one project. RenderStream connects engine content to Designer. Try the content buttons to see the same stage take on a different look.
subtitle_4: Keep the whole show in sync.
description_4: Use the Designer timeline, cues, APIs and protocols to synchronise visuals with connected systems. Porta gives operators a templated interface for graphics control in studios, stadiums and venues.
subtitle_5: Scale up. Prepare for the unexpected.
description_5: Media servers process and output content; render nodes add dedicated real-time processing. Multi-machine sessions and understudy backups support resilient delivery. Try the offline simulation to see the backup concept.
